lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Primary high-intensity centroids are arranged in three distinct horizontal rows posterior to the fifth gill slit. The median row exhibits the highest luminance and most regular spatial periodicity between coordinates.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, forming a structural grid where circular spots are predominantly situated at the centers of the vertical band segments.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the mid-upper flank, defined by a sharp luminance transition from high-intensity reflection on the dorsal edge to low-intensity shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of small, high-luminance circular spots concentrated primarily along its leading edge and distal tip.
